logline: A midnight old library: closing hour to the last unread page.
youtubeTitle: [playlist] QuietLY · 深夜舊圖書館 — Slow Mandarin Jazz for Night Reading

comics.en: A lamp stays loyal to one desk.
Dust turns footsteps into soft drums.
Closing hour is still a kind of opening.
